artboards.title: Applications — All (expanded row, held, failed, refusal)

annotations.text:
Screen 1 · Application Shell — APPROVED 2026-09-14 in Stitch (project 14960912770210209518).
Copied here from Stitch screens 1faa69250fb54fd483095f1877385017 (shell) and 8c3f224648274563afec62e50123bd4c (component sheet), which stay the source of truth.
Decisions: no pagination (lists use tabs + scroll); breadcrumb names only where you are; component sample content stays neutral.
The component sheet copied as approved in Stitch, including its own labels (spec v1.4, token footers). Later screens reuse its badges, buttons, inputs, table, dialog, toasts and edge states.

Screen 2 · Dashboard — APPROVED 2026-09-14.
Uses /api/overview + /api/run/status today.
Needs backend slices: EV1 (Activity feed), OC1 (card count in Needs you / sidebar).
First run: shown while nothing has been scored. The checklist replaces the empty tables; the Facts row turns amber below min_hard (10).

Screen 3 · Applications — awaiting approval.
One poll of /api/applications?show=skipped every 3 s; no backend changes.
The run strip and the no-scheduler notice sit above the tabs on every tab (drawn on Queue only).
Not drawn: Start / Resume top-bar states, loading skeleton, empty Queue / Skipped, the date forms for Mark applied and It was submitted.

All tab: status chips filter client-side. Row chevron expands Why this score, the resume sent and Record outcome. In-progress jobs appear here, not in Queue (in_flight counts as terminal). Held only exists once real submission is switched on. A refused action shows inline under its row.
Skipped: gate skips (stage = scored) get Track anyway; hard-filter skips (stage = hard) are read-only with the recorded reason. Naukri is discovery-only, so no Naukri job ever shows Apply.

Screen 4 · Job Details — awaiting approval.
Needs JD1 (GET /api/jobs/{id}) for one payload; every button calls an existing route.
Shown: an interrupted session (primary = Continue). Other header states per spec: Apply / Open draft / Open chat / It was submitted / Record outcome / Track anyway.
Decision: the interrupted banner is amber (it waits on you), not sky.

Screen 5 · Chat — awaiting approval.
Needs MS1 for the model picker (PUT /api/settings/models; run model for the locked state).
Cards use a tinted header strip + label instead of a left-border accent.
Home: the Conversations rail replaces today's drawer rail.

Job chat: your note shows its delivery status underneath; the CONFIRM card shows memory used (in the payload today, never shown before) and read-only secret rows. The model picker is locked while the session is live.

Screen 6 · Facts — awaiting approval.
Needs FC1 (cited_by per fact) for the Cited chips, the disabled Delete and the edit warning. The 409 guard stays the authority.

Screen 7 · Resumes — awaiting approval.
Needs RS1 (job_id + prompt_version per version) for the job links and Prompt column. No re-tailor action exists, so none is offered. An unresolved citation shows as a rose Unknown fact chip.

Screen 8 · Profile — awaiting approval. No backend changes.
Month pickers for dates (native type=month gives YYYY-MM). Education gains reordering client-side. Sticky save bar; leaving with unsaved changes asks first.

Screen 9 · Settings — awaiting approval.
Needs MS1 for the Apply agent model. List fields are tag inputs but still send comma-joined strings. No contact fields (M6). A broken brief hides sections 1–3 behind an explanation (not drawn).

Screen 10 · Memory — awaiting approval.
Needs MM1 (source_job_id) for Learned from. 'Ask me again next time' is replaced by 'Re-confirm every 30 days'; Due to re-confirm is computed client-side in naive UTC.

Screen 11 · Logins — awaiting approval.
Needs LG1 (POST /api/logins with account_domain check, 409 on an existing login → Replace? confirm, 409 when CREDENTIAL_KEY is missing). Passwords are never returned or shown.
Sidebar is imported by every screen artboard so navigation stays identical. Tweaks: active item, and the status card variant (running, first run, or the Shell's exact card).
